sentence: This project builds computer models that read DNA sequences to work out how they control gene activity in the genome.
This project studies how diabetes and aging together damage the cornea and slow its wound healing, using zebrafish.
This project studies how thalidomide and related drugs bring proteins to an enzyme, and why they cause birth defects.
This project builds a group of baboons free of certain viruses and tests them as an animal model of Alzheimer's disease.
This project builds a portable imaging device that measures how cells use energy in tumors and how they respond to treatment.
This project builds computer tools that analyze large gene-editing screens of single cells to show how genetic changes affect cells.
This project compares two ways of using stem cells to model a fat tissue disorder called partial lipodystrophy.
This project studies how a protein called Pellino1 helps skin cells defend against viruses.
This project studies how hardship in childhood changes the thinking skills that children use when reading.
This project uses imaging and exercise testing to study how body composition and heart blood vessel problems relate to heart disease.
This project builds a web-based tool that helps researchers make sense of results from genomics or proteomics studies.
This project studies how cancer immunotherapies that regulate immune checkpoints cause injury and remodeling in the heart.
This project gets an instrument that measures the mass of single particles to study how proteins interact.
This project studies how structural changes in DNA contribute to autism by building a way to detect them in sequencing data.
This project looks for molecular and imaging markers that track how limb girdle muscular dystrophy gets worse over time.
This project studies how mitochondria in neurons from patients affect nerve cell signaling and may contribute to schizophrenia.
This project provides genomics technologies, including whole genome sequencing, and data analysis help to cancer researchers.
This project traces how blood forming stem cells are born during development.
This project studies how DNA damage inside tumor cells sets off immune responses against cancer.
This project tests whether a small viral peptide binds the virus membrane and helps HIV fuse with cells.
